feeds.title: Kyle Michelle Weddings Blog
feeds.description: We are passionate about helping you find your voice for your dream day. Your wedding should represent you as a couple. From venue & decor to music & photography, Kyle Michelle Weddings and Events will provide you with the personal, unique, and delightfully unexpected. We are all about organization, creativity, design, and implementation.

feeds.title: World Bride Magazine
feeds.description: World Bride Magazine (WBM) is positioned as the premier multicultural and multiethnic global lifestyle bridal magazine. The number one source for truly diverse wedding information, from destination weddings to wedding favors. World Bride Magazine share their global insights with all happy couples to be.

feeds.title: Sophisticated Weddings
feeds.description: Sophisticated Weddings Magazine decided to create a new way to instantly deliver you the best of everything bridal in New York City and beyond. Whether it's the city's hottest venues, designers, or just a little inspiration as you plan for the most exciting day of your life, the magazine is committed to keeping you up-to-date with our favorite finds.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Weddings and Engagements
feeds.description: our website contains articles discussing weddings and engagements, providing news, and ideas as well. The new york times is a media website offering news, from around the world, business, sports, weather, and what not.

feeds.title: Bride & Blossom
feeds.description: Bride & Blossom is the artistic vision of Founder, Rachel Trimarco. The concept for a wedding floral boutique sprung from Rachel's experience visualizing a lush and exquisite floral landscape for her own special day. We keep this in mind when working with our clients to perfect wedding floral designs that are a sincere reflection of their style whether it be classic elegance, modern chic, or natural romance.

feeds.title: Danila and Lana's Wedding Photography Blog
feeds.description: We are a boutique photo & video company based in Brooklyn, New York. The only important thing you should know about us is that we are full of unique ideas and funky energy. And we are always ready to create legendary photos and videos!

feeds.title: One Wedding House Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about the adventures that our couples take It's about advice that you can use while preparing for your own wedding in. It's about locations where you can have your wedding ceremony, ideas on how to decorate your venue and create a memorable and personalized wedding day. And of course, it's about things you can see & do while you are visiting New York.

feeds.title: Megan & Kenneth Blog
feeds.description: Megan & Kenneth shares wedding photography in New York, NY. As NY and Brooklyn Wedding Photographers, our whole thing is about making sure you're happy, comfortable, and relaxed in front of the camera. Because, between us, we've got the photography smarts, the goofy jokes, a winning mix of Canadian and Southern charm.

feeds.title: Jenny Fu Blog
feeds.description: With a passion for capturing memories and a keen eye for detail, I've been turning moments into keepsakes since I first picked up a camera at ten years old. After assisting a fashion photographer for two years, I knew that wedding photography was my calling. It's an honor to be able to bring my clients' cherished memories back to life, long after their wedding day has passed.

feeds.title: Over The Moon » Weddings
feeds.description: We are the ultimate destination for modern, stylish, and just plain fun wedding inspiration. We feature aspirational, yet relatable, real weddings from couples around the world-the kind you can't help but obsess over on Instagram. From the latest dress trends to celebrity engagements and weddings, answers to burning etiquette questions, and all of the decor and inspiration ideas you could ever want, we are the go-to source.

feeds.title: L&L Style Photo Blog
feeds.description: We are L&L Style Photo, a team of TOP-RATED AWARD-WINNING wedding photographers offering wedding photography as well as fun NY City Hall and New York City Elopement coverage with a fresh photojournalist and editorial approach. We tell love stories. With our photography + officiant package, we offer full flexibility regarding locations and time.

feeds.title: De Nueva Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nicki. My mission is to make getting your picture taken a fun, not stressful. It's my job is to make the wedding photography process as easy as possible. I make sure you're taken care of so you can enjoy that extra awesome person you're going to be marrying. My favorite weddings are those that reflect the uniqueness of the couple.

feeds.title: Hudson River Photographer Blog
feeds.description: Diane has been photographing weddings for 15 years, bringing together a background in filmmaking and art direction. Nominated as one of the top 100 wedding photographers in the USA by Brandsmasher, her work has been featured in such publications as Brides Magazine, New York Magazine, Manhattan Bride, Out Magazine, Carats & Cake, Junebug Weddings, Style Me Pretty, and the New York Times.

feeds.title: The Preston Barn Blog
feeds.description: The Preston Barn holds up to 220 guests and is constructed of reclaimed historic barns from the Hudson Valley. Old Drovers Inn weddings at the Preston Barn can also host your pre-wedding and post-wedding events such as rehearsal dinner, after-party, and send-off brunch.

feeds.title: Alinato Events Blog
feeds.description: Check out my Blog and learn more about the ins and outs of events and weddings in NYC straight from the source! Hi! Alyssa here. As a wedding planner, they call me the 'Wedding Whisperer' for my intense attention to detail (borderline OCD). I will keep you on track with your timeline and well within budget.

feeds.title: Known Together Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Blake, I'm the photographer that creates space for real moments to occur. I look to re-invent the way weddings are thought of, or even take weddings back to the time when they were much simpler. My process called the 'free to feel' experience has been a culmination of many years of learning how to allow space for moments to occur.

feeds.title: Small Shindigs Blog
feeds.description: Small Shindigs supports fun-loving couples in creating intimate wedding celebrations filled with meaningful connections. Through logistic & creative planning, I connect with couples to create a day that's an authentic reflection of them to celebrate alongside those they love & cherish most. Find Wedding planning thoughts, advice, and tips for small and intimate weddings. in our blogs.

feeds.title: Brian Hatton Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am Brian Hatton. I create images that show the nuances of personal connections in a way that is unpretentiously refined and refreshingly real. My work is clean, contemporary, and true to life. It didn't take me long to realize that the marriage of a carefully practiced technique and an ability to communicate beyond words is what makes a great musician as well as a great photographer.

feeds.title: Ang Weddings Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2011, Ang Weddings and Events is a boutique event planning company founded by Tzo Ai Ang and based in New York City. Ang Weddings and Events has been named a top wedding planner by Martha Stewart Weddings, one of the best planners in the U.S. by BRIDES, an expert by The Knot. Tzo Ai's work has been featured in Martha Stewart Weddings, Harper's Bazaar, The Knot, BRIDES, Grace Ormonde and Style Me Pretty.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Bride
feeds.description: Brooklyn Bride was the first wedding blog to focus exclusively on modern weddings. Founded by Vané Broussard, an interior designer by day, and a bridal blogger by night, the site features up and coming vendors in all fields such as photography, calligraphy, invitations, fashion, and gifts, along with coverage of bridal shows, shop reviews, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Love Inc.
feeds.description: Love Inc. is a leading equally minded wedding publication, devoted to creating original content targeted to both straight and same-sex couples, setting us apart from other publications in this swiftly evolving world of weddings.

feeds.title: The Budget Savvy Bride Blog
feeds.description: Plan Your Wedding on a Budget You Can Actually Afford with tools, resources, & advice from The Budget Savvy Bride, the #1 Wedding Budget Blog! The Budget Savvy Bride is the best resource for couples planning a wedding on a budget. We've been helping couples plan Savvy Weddings since 2008 with our money-saving tips, simple DIY projects, practical wedding planning advice, and much more.

feeds.title: Janelle Brooke Photography Blog » Wedding
feeds.description: The blog offers wedding photography ideas, our client stories, and more. Hi! I am Janelle Brooke. As a wedding and family photographer, my days are filled to the brim with love stories, happy families, and brand-new babies. This brings me joy daily and is why I am constantly pinching myself that this is my job. I have created this blog to give you a place to scroll through the happenings at JBP because all of this happiness shouldn't be kept in a bottle it should be shared!

feeds.title: Julian Ribinik Wedding Photography Blog
feeds.description: We're Julian & Evgenia. Julian had a special passion for photojournalism and street photography while Evgenia really enjoyed creating sensual imagery. Together they capture the most intimate moments of their couples' stories.

feeds.title: Sava Studio Blog
feeds.description: We're Sava, a small studio of photographers who bonded over our similar educational background, love of art, & general affinity for timeless wedding photos. Our promise is to help you relive each moment of your wedding day every time you look at your images, make you feel comfortable in front of the camera, and blend into the crowd like we're your guests.

feeds.title: Mile Square Moments Blog
feeds.description: I'm a Hoboken-based wedding photographer, I'm a newlywed, I'm a coffee addict, I'm obsessed with candles, and I still watch reruns of Friends and listen to 90s punk rock bands. Check out my NYC and NJ wedding photo portfolio to see the couples I've worked with and read my blog to read about their love stories.

feeds.title: Claudia Oliver Photography Blog
feeds.description: Claudia Oliver Photography Blog posts about weddings, engagements, portraits, and more. They also provide ideas and tips for photoshoots.

feeds.title: Sascha Reinking Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Sascha Reinking. I create authentic images that capture not just the visuals, but the feelings. And I do it with all the love and laughter you'd want for your wedding day, from sun up to starry skies.

feeds.title: Sara Wight Photography Blog
feeds.description: At Sara Wight Photography, we believe in wedding photography with intention. To us, every moment of the wedding day is special. So in that, it is our desire to create a body of images that include both the big, momentous photos as well as the quieter, in-between candids and portraits. It is our goal is to make you and your partner feel as comfortable, calm, and relaxed in front of the camera as possible-allowing you feel beautiful and in the moment on your wedding day.

feeds.title: Cantor Pincus' Wedding Blog
feeds.description: Welcome, and congratulations! This is your time of love, hope, and dreams. Two people in love standing in front of me -- a wonderful sight. I'd love to be the one to bring you to and through the gates of marriage. Check out my blog for everything from choosing a venue to how to get over pre-wedding jitters!

feeds.title: Erica Camille Photography » NYC Weddings
feeds.description: Check out my blog for wedding ideas, LBGTQ weddings, engagements, and more. I am Erica Camille. My photography is a commentary and recorded history of the human experience in all its expressions of beauty, struggle, bravery, and mystery. I believe that candid interactions, ridiculous quirks, and vulnerable moments of sharing between family and friends define what it means to be alive and they deserve to be documented, preserved, and remembered.

feeds.title: Dare to Dream Blog
feeds.description: Dare to dream is the new way of wedding planning. We specialize in small weddings and micro weddings. We believe that the day of a wedding should be easy and stress-free. We also strongly feel that you don't need to spend a fortune to make a wedding wonderful. Luxury weddings can be and are very affordable. Our team of seasoned wedding professionals includes event planners and photographers that know the gems of the city.

feeds.title: LLG Events Blog
feeds.description: Inspiration from real weddings as well as hot news, wedding trends, philanthropic weddings stories, and industry insights from our expert wedding planners and knowledgeable partners and vendors. Whether you are a wedding professional, a bride or groom to be, you'll find inspiration and entertainment reading our love stories and wedding advice

feeds.title: Forever Photography Blog
feeds.description: We are a passionate wedding photography team focusing on love's true emotions. We love images that tug at our heart strings and fill us with joy. Our photography style is authentic and honest. We spend your wedding day striving to capture moments you'll treasure forever in a natural way.

feeds.title: Arius Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hudson Valley wedding photographer, Samantha June of Arius Photography, is a creative documentary wedding photographer serving the Hudson Valley, Upstate New York.

feeds.title: Rebecca Ou Photography Blog
feeds.description: Get bridal tips, and read stories on my blog page. Hey there, I am Rebecca Ou, a Fine Art Wedding Photographer, specializing in iconic, timeless images. I do photography because I believe it's the closest thing we have to time travel. I aim to create your story genuinely and hope that you can relive the happiness you felt on your wedding day through keepsake moving and still imagery.

feeds.title: New York Bride Magazine
feeds.description: New York Bride Magazine is a publication that focuses on weddings in the New York City area. The magazine covers topics such as Upcoming Styles and Trends for the Bridal Year, Inspiration, News, Insider Tips From New York Bride Celebrities, Inspirational Designs and More.

feeds.title: Siobhan Stanton Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am here to make your photography experience as seamless as possible. Being a wedding photographer, one of my specialties is making people instantly feel comfortable with me. I will direct you throughout the day, in a way that captures you and your spouse in the best way, while allowing you to make it your own.

feeds.title: ArtVesta Studio Blog
feeds.description: Tatiana Valerie, the founder of Artvesta Studio, is an award-winning, internationally published photographer based in Manhattan, NY. Tatiana was academically trained in art and photography. Her work has been featured in Harper's Bazaar, Marie Claire, InStyle, New York Weddings magazines, Style Me Pretty, Betrothed Magazine, and The New York Times.
